video_title: Philly Not a REAL Sports Town?! 🤨 Josh & Jalen Spark Viral Debate After Dominating Sixers

quotes.speaker: Josh Hart
quotes.summary_phrase: Josh Hart defines a true sports town, excluding Philadelphia

text_blocks.text: I still would not retract or recant my statements that Philly not being a sports town. It's not a sports town. You cannot be a sports town if that happens. I would never, I Boston, sports town.

text_blocks.text: You won't see anyone take over their arena. So yes, I'll say it's more of a sports town than Philly. They're never going to say that because they don't have to. Because that's one of the places that's a sports town and you will not take over that arena. I don't think you're going to take over the arena in New York.
